segments.name: Pharmaceutical manufacturing and selling
segments.description: Single operating segment engaged in pharmaceutical manufacturing and selling, supplying personalized goods to customers through domestic and overseas sales.
segments.evidence: For management purposes, the Company operates in one business unit based on the products sold, and its sole operating segment is pharmaceutical manufacturing and selling.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for the production and sale of personalized goods, with purchase orders setting prices and delivery terms.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue from production and sales of personalized goods including domestic sales and oversea sales.
